9. Loss of Nuance: Simplifying complex historical figures to fit modern moral judgments risks losing important aspects of their character and the historical context.

10. Impediment to Learning: Viewing the past through a contemporary moral lens can prevent us from learning from history's complexities. It may stop us from acknowledging the progress that has been made over time and the mistakes that must not be repeated.
